say:1:1130719001:1.text: Bounty hunters are a bunch of jerks who would do anything for money!
say:1:1130719001:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人是一群为了钱不择手段的混蛋！

say:2:1130719002:1.text: A bounty hunter hired Jacob and me as helpers and promised us ten coins a day on top of room and board.
say:2:1130719002:1.source_cn: 之前一个赏金猎人说要雇佣我和雅各布做帮工，每天十个铜币...

say:3:1130719003:1.text: We fed his horses and carried his goods day and night.
say:3:1130719003:1.source_cn: 我和雅各布每天给他喂马搬货，从早忙到晚。

say:4:1130719004:1.text: But he made up all sorts of excuses to not pay us and stuffed us in a stable to sleep. We barely had any meat!
say:4:1130719004:1.source_cn: 结果他一直找各种借口不给我们佣金，让我们住马棚，连肉都...

say:5:1130719005:1.text: In the end, he even tried to send us to work for the Quicksand Claws!
say:5:1130719005:1.source_cn: 到最后，他甚至还想把我们骗去给流沙之爪当劳工！

say:6:1130719006:1.text: Fortunately, we saw his true colors just in time to get away.
say:6:1130719006:1.source_cn: 还好我们及时看清了他的真面目，逃了出来！
